[S27T2][S27T3]. Dave shared a photo of a city skyline at sunset with a clock tower — "Look at this magnificent sunset I captured on camera. It's truly breathtaking to witness such beautiful sunsets! The sky looks like it's on fire!" [S27T4]. Calvin: "Wow, that view looks awesome!" and asked what city it is and whether Dave has taken any good pictures lately [S27T5]. [S27T7]. Dave: thanks, and yes that's the clock tower — he snapped it at sunset and the colors were stunning; photography helps him capture and appreciate the beauty of nature — "It's been an awesome creative outlet and I'm loving it." (Calvin's side in the Music and Boston trip sections of this file; Dave's side in the Photography section of /memories/dave.md) [S27T8]. The conversation continued: Calvin asked how Dave's car project was going, and Dave said "The car project is doing well" — he "just finished restoring it and it looks amazing" — and invited Calvin over to check it out ("Wanna come by and check it out?"); Calvin: "That's awesome, Dave! Your car project sounds amazing." (Dave's side in the Classic cars and Relationships sections of /memories/dave.md); when Dave asked how everything was with the music, Calvin said he'd had some great collaborations recently, his album is almost finished, and he'll send Dave some previews soon (details in ## Music); the chat closed with the two arranging a catch-up when free — Calvin: "Let me know when you're free for a catch-up." Dave: "Cool, Calvin! Can't wait to hear it. Let me know when you're free and take it easy!" Calvin: "Cheers! I'll let you know when I'm free. Bye!" [S27T9][S27T10][S27T11][S27T12][S27T13].
